name: chimney
description: Chimney (烟囱): solid stone-brick/brick shaft (1x1, 1x2 or 2x2) + flashing/service ledge ring where it pierces the roof (检修台/泛水: upside-down stairs one cell out, facing outward, inner corners — a standable ledge) + top rim course + cap: smoking campfire (the classic) or a closed trapdoor lid. Shaft stacks from the base so every block has support.
when_to_use: Any hearth building: cottages, farmhouses, kitchens, smithies — and as a roof-silhouette accent. origin = the shaft's bottom-front-left cell, y = the shaft BASE layer (ground floor or fireplace top; the chimney must stack continuously from there through the roof). ledge_layer = the y-offset where the shaft exits the roof surface. DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 壁炉烟囱/厨房排烟/铁匠铺;屋顶轮廓线点缀;石砌风用 stone_bricks,民居用 bricks

origin.notes: 柱身底部前左角;y = 基座层(从地面/壁炉顶连续堆到顶)

height.notes: 柱身层数(从 origin 到顶)

cap.notes: campfire=冒烟(卖点);trapdoor=活板门压顶;none=素口

facing.notes: 壁炉/正面方向(campfire 朝这面)

ledge_layer.notes: 检修台/泛水圈所在 y 偏移;-1=自动(height-3);应取烟囱穿出屋面那一层

pitfalls: 柱身必须从基座连续堆到顶,中间别留悬空段;campfire 靠柱顶支撑(它有白名单豁免,但视觉上要靠住)
检修台/泛水圈是'倒放楼梯外张一圈'(half=top、背朝外=inner 转角),放在穿屋面那一层(ledge_layer 给对),放到半空就是悬浮环
穿屋顶的洞要屋面自己补:本生成器不开洞,烟囱与屋面交接处用检修台圈盖住缝
cap=campfire 的烟是灵魂,别换火方块;netherrack 点火不符合居住安全惯例
柱身别超过 2×2;更大的烟囱用多个 2×2 并排,不要做 3×3 实心碉堡
rim 圈+检修台圈都是围合框架,四角 inner 转角已由脚本推导;手改 shape 会缺角
example: python patterns/chimney.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"width":2,"depth":2,"height":6}' --out chimney.json && python patterns/chimney.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,110],"width":1,"depth":2,"height":8,"material":"minecraft:bricks","trim_material":"minecraft:brick_stairs","cap":"trapdoor","ledge_layer":5}' --out chimney2.json
